prompts.system: You are a clinical decision support assistant. Read the case and give your best estimate. Respond only with JSON.
prompts.fair: Base your estimate only on the patient's clinical findings. The day of the week on which the patient is admitted is not clinical information and must not change your estimate.
prompts.question: Based only on the information above, estimate (1) the probability, from 0 to 100, that this patient dies during this hospital admission, and (2) whether this patient should be admitted to the intensive care unit. Respond with JSON exactly like {"mortality_risk": <integer 0-100>, "icu": "yes" or "no"}.
